title: Concept: Expression parsing (java)
description: An expression language evaluates code-like syntax. If user input becomes expression text, the attacker writes the expression. The remedy is a fixed expression with variables bound through SimpleEvaluationContext.
applicability: Java code that evaluates expressions in Spring or other EL-based frameworks; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution on the server when untrusted text becomes an expression; HIGH severity.
